answers.description: Independent café on the canal in Hebden Bridge. Breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked here each morning. Dogs, prams and muddy boots all welcome.

headline.text: Your independent café by the canal in Hebden Bridge

hero.subhead: Breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked here each morning. Dogs, prams and muddy boots all welcome.

quote.text: We wanted a café where everyone feels welcome, muddy boots and all.

profile.body: Pop in any morning, no booking needed, just follow the towpath to our door.

plan.title: What you get
plan.body: Everything baked here each morning, served by the water.

service.title: Baked here each morning
service.body: Our cakes are baked fresh on site every morning. Come and see what's just come out of the oven.

about.body: Bramble and Bean is an independent café on the canal in Hebden Bridge. We bake cakes here each morning and serve breakfasts and sourdough toasties. Dogs, prams and muddy boots are all welcome, whoever you are.

heading.text: How a visit to Bramble and Bean works

steps.lead: Finding us and settling in is simple. Here's what to expect when you come by the canal.

items.title: Find us by the canal
items.body: We're easy to spot on the canal in Hebden Bridge. Just follow the towpath and look out for our door.

items.title: Settle in
items.body: Bring the dog, the pram or your muddy boots. Grab a table and take a moment by the water.

items.title: Order at the counter
items.body: Choose from breakfasts, toasties and cakes baked that morning. We'll bring it over when ready.

items.title: Relax by the water
items.body: Take your time with your food and the view. There's no rush at Bramble and Bean.

items.title: Baked here each morning
items.body: Our cakes are baked fresh on site every morning. Come and see what's just come out of the oven today.

items.title: Hearty breakfasts
items.body: Start your day with a proper breakfast by the water. Simple, satisfying food cooked with care.

items.title: Sourdough toasties
items.body: Our sourdough toasties are made to order using good bread and simple fillings. A canalside favourite.

services.lead: Whoever you are and whatever the weather, there's a place for you at our table by the canal.

items.title: Dogs welcome
items.body: Bring your dog along and settle in. We're used to four-legged visitors by the water.

items.title: Prams welcome
items.body: Plenty of room to park a pram while you enjoy breakfast, toasties or cake.

items.title: Muddy boots welcome
items.body: Been walking the towpath? Come straight in, muddy boots and all, no fuss.

heading.text: Come and visit us by the canal

cta.body: Breakfasts, toasties and cakes baked here each morning, with a warm welcome waiting for you.

items.question: Where exactly are you on the canal in Hebden Bridge?
items.answer: We're right on the canal. Just follow the towpath and look out for our door.

items.question: Do you bake everything on site?
items.answer: Yes, our cakes are baked here each morning, along with our breakfasts and sourdough toasties.

items.question: Can I bring my dog?
items.answer: Yes, dogs are all welcome, along with prams and muddy boots.

items.question: Do I need to book a table?
items.answer: No, just pop in. Grab a table and settle in by the water.

items.question: What can I order?
items.answer: Breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked here each morning, ordered at the counter.
